description: This Dart source file defines a data model for categories within a financial tracking application, including an enumeration for category types (income or expense), a class representing category data with methods for mapping to/from database records, and utility functions for color and string representations.

classes.name: CategoryType
classes.description: An enumeration that specifies whether a category is for expenses or income, with helper methods to map from DB values and to retrieve their string representation for storage.

classes.name: CategoryModel
classes.description: A data class representing a category with properties for id, name, type, and color, including methods for constructing from database maps, converting to maps for database operations, copying with modifications, and utility getters.

methods.name: CategoryType.fromDb
methods.description: Converts a database string value to a CategoryType, defaulting to expense.

methods.name: CategoryType.get dbValue
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the CategoryType for database storage.

methods.name: CategoryModel.fromMap
methods.description: Constructs a CategoryModel instance from a map retrieved from the database.

methods.name: CategoryModel.toMap
methods.description: Converts the CategoryModel instance into a map suitable for database insert/update operations.

methods.name: CategoryModel.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current CategoryModel with optional new values.

methods.name: CategoryModel.asColor
methods.description: Provides a Flutter Color object from the stored ARGB integer.
